responsibility: Defines the reusable C++ function_base class hierarchy used to implement Arm MVE intrinsics in GCC. It provides generic helpers and partial implementations for common intrinsic behaviors—such as unspec-based expansion across signed/unsigned/floating variants, predicated and _n suffixed forms, tuple-valued operations, full-width loads/stores, extending loads, truncating stores, and side-effect classification via call_properties—plus the FUNCTION macro that instantiates global function objects. This header is the core implementation framework that arm-mve-builtins-base.cc builds on to express individual intrinsic semantics compactly.
